newsitem.title: UK: Firm says investment at risk if UK out of EMU-FT.
newsitem.headline: Firm says investment at risk if UK out of EMU-FT.

text.p: A leading Italian industrialist believes future investment in Britain is at risk if it stays out of a single European currency, the Financial Times said on Tuesday.

Umberto Quadrino, chief executive of New Holland, the world's second biggest tractor manufacturer, said he was seriously concerned the company might reconsider future plans to invest in its Essex plant if European Economic and Monetary union (EMU) went ahead without Britain.
He is the latest in a series of executives who have questioned Britain's attractiveness as a business location if it stays out of EMU.
If monetary union went ahead without Britain, "for sure" New Holland would suffer, the Financial Times quoted Quadrino saying.
